visual_review.single_pose_no_overlay: 一张只有一个姿势，未见文字、编号、箭头、拼图或水印。
visual_review.camera_equipment: 各动作组沿同一侧向/斜侧全身构图；本组台阶、扶手外观与设置保持；AI编辑存在轻微材质与局部轮廓差异。

review_limitations: 正侧视角与同色长裤使左右脚身份差异较小；通过近侧屈髋大腿与远侧腿遮挡关系核对两侧交换。
静态图不能证明动作时序、实际负荷或临床适用性。

attempts.full_prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: one raw rehabilitation demonstration photograph, action 101 step 01. Edit target and camera/equipment anchor: the provided existing photograph. Preserve exactly the same woman, face, black ponytail, white short-sleeve t-shirt, dark gray trousers and white shoes; same gray-blue seamless studio, lighting, lens perspective, full-body framing, same rectangular gray low step with black top and same fixed silver handrail position and design. Change ONLY her pose and resulting necessary position: she faces screen-right and is now standing on the FLOOR just BEFORE/BEHIND the step, on the screen-left end of the step. Both feet are completely flat on the floor, side by side and entirely outside/left of the step. One hand gently grips the same fixed rail, the other arm relaxed. Stand upright in preparation. Step top completely empty. Keep the entire head, hands, two feet and full step/support contacts visible. Since she is one step-height lower than the supplied photo her head should naturally be lower; do not resize her body or move/resize the step. Clear floor behind her for stepping backwards. One woman, one single pose, no collage, no duplicate body, no text, no numbers, no arrows, no logos, no watermark. Natural limb proportions, plausible fingers, unbroken joint connections.
attempts.reason: 第一尝试姿势正确，但台阶高度和横向位置与后续s02锚点存在漂移；使用s02进行定向修正，选用新生成s01。源输出保留在工具生成目录，最终steps规范名已对应修正图。

intermediates: 开始曾复制旧101单图为s03候选，最终未复用；规范名已替换为新s03，本轮s03_new中间副本已移除；原有train单图和既有进度JSON未修改。
limitations: 审核仅为生成照片的视觉/姿势/接触/比例检查，未进行医疗专业验收、动态动作验证或像素级摄影配准。
与参考人物身份是视觉近似匹配，不能声明生物身份验证。
禁止文字与箭头要求按照片层核对；后续文字层另行排版。
